latest_release.body: ## [11.27.0](https://github.com/zwave-js/zwave-js-ui/compare/v11.26.2...v11.27.0) (2026-11-16) 🎄 **Hello Z-Wave JS UI friends,** Another year is almost over, and like every December I want to stop for a moment and say thank you to all of you. 🙏 This year was a special one. Z-Wave JS moved to the [Open Home Foundation](https://www.openhomefoundation.org/), and thanks to that I finally had the chance to meet [AlCalzone](https://github.com/AlCalzone) in person after years of working together only through GitHub and chats. I also met a lot of nice people and great developers along the way, all because of this project. It still amazes me how far a side project can take you. ❤️ ### What we built this year Since last Christmas we shipped more than 25 releases and about 300 commits, and followed Z-Wave JS from 15.18 up to 15.32. Some highlights: - 🔐 **Credentials management UI** for user codes and other access credentials - 📡 **Multicast and broadcast groups** to control many nodes with one command - 🧩 **Configuration templates** to save device parameters and apply them to other devices - 🕸️ **A truly dynamic network graph** that updates live, plus "refresh all neighbors" from the Mesh page - 🏠 Better Home Assistant discovery: Window Covering CC as covers, `suggested_area` from the node location, reactive power/energy and more sensor classes, and an option to enable Configuration CC entities by default - 🔋 **Last Awake** column for battery nodes, interview progress as a percentage, min/max/step hints on values, confirmation before destructive config parameters - ♿ **Accessibility** work for screen readers and keyboard users - 🔌 Embedding Z-Wave JS UI in other software, and a trusted API on a separate network/IP/port - 🐞 Better debug captures (driver restart option, environment info) - 🤖 A docs bot that answers common questions in issues and discussions, so we can spend more time on code ### 🗺️ Floorplan mode The last feature I want to show you is the new **Floorplan** mode for the network graph ([#4877](https://github.com/zwave-js/zwave-js-ui/pull/4877)). A big thanks goes to [BiloxiGeek](https://github.com/BiloxiGeek) for that! 🙏 You upload a picture of your house (one per floor if you like), place your nodes on it and see their routes, speeds, battery levels and weak links where the devices really are. When a node has a bad route, you can now see where it is and how many walls are between it and the controller 🏡 ### What's next The next big thing is the **UI refactor**: a full rework of the dashboard, node and controller views is in progress ([#4746](https://github.com/zwave-js/zwave-js-ui/pull/4746)), together with a backend refactor ([#4722](https://github.com/zwave-js/zwave-js-ui/issues/4722)) that splits the big classes, turns on strict TypeScript and adds more tests, while keeping the HTTP and WebSocket APIs fully compatible. It's a lot of work, but it will make the app nicer to use and much easier to maintain. ### A personal note On a more personal note, my full-time job has been taking a lot of my energy lately and I have less free time than I'd like to spend in OSS. I will still always find some time for this project, because of the community that has grown around it. We are now at more than 1.2k stars and 140+ contributors, and I'm really proud of that. 💪 ### 🎁 A little Christmas gift As every year, if you'd like to support us in a different way, AlCalzone and I have updated our Amazon wishlists. We really love this kind of support, and every gift under the tree reminds us of all of you: - [robertsLando](https://www.amazon.it/hz/wishlist/ls/2LYWFKB0WTSNN?ref_=wl_share) (Z-Wave JS UI) 🎁 - [AlCalzone](https://www.amazon.de/hz/wishlist/ls/1BJPJ73TKD23P?ref_=wl_share) (Z-Wave JS driver) 🎁 Thank you for the code, the

Store](https://snapcraft.io/static/images/badges/en/snap-store-black.svg)](https://snapcraft.io/zwave-js-ui) Full featured Z-Wave **Control Panel** and MQTT **Gateway**. - **Backend**: [NodeJS](https://nodejs.org/en/), [Express](https://expressjs.com/), [socket.io](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io), [MQTTjs](https://github.com/mqttjs/MQTT.js), [zwavejs](https://github.com/zwave-js/node-zwave-js), [Webpack](https://webpack.js.org/) - **Frontend**: [Vue](https://vuejs.org/), [socket.io](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io), [Vuetify](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify) ## Main features - **Control Panel UI**: Directly control your nodes and their values from the UI, including: - *Nodes management*: Add, remove, and configure all nodes in your Z-Wave network - *Firmware updates*: Update device firmware using manufacturer-supplied firmware files - *Groups associations*: Add, edit, and remove direct node associations - *Z-Wave JS Exposed*: Provides full-access to Z-Wave JS's APIs - **Full-Featured Z-Wave to MQTT Gateway**: Expose Z-Wave devices to an MQTT broker in a fully configurable manner - **Secured**: Supports *HTTPS* and *user authentication* - **Scene Management**: Create scenes and trigger them by using MQTT apis (with timeout support) - **Debug Logs in the UI**: See debug logs directly from the UI - **Access Store Files in the UI**: Access the files are stored in the persistent `store` folder directly from the UI - **Network Graph**: Provides a beautiful map showing how nodes are communicating with the controller - **Automatic/Scheduled backups**: Scheduled backup of NVM and store directory. It's also possible to enable automatic backups of NVM before every node inclusion/exclusion/replace, this ensures to create a safe restore point before any operation that can cause a network corruption. - **Zniffer Support**: Supports Zniffer mode for debugging Z-Wave traffic - **Dianogsitics**: Use Healtcheck and Link quality tools to diagnose network issues ## Software integrations - [Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/): using the official [addon](https://github.com/hassio-addons/addon-zwave-js-ui) or standalone installation through plain MQTT or MQTT Discovery. See [docs](https://zwave-js.github.io/zwave-js-ui/#/homeassistant/homeassistant-mqtt) - [Domoticz](https://www.domoticz.com/): using MQTT Discovery. See [docs](https://www.domoticz.com/wiki/Zwave-JS-UI) - [OpenHAB](https://www.openhab.org/): using MQTT Discovery. See [docs](https://community.openhab.org/t/zwave-js-ui-in-place-of-oh-zwave-binding/150007/102) - [Jeedom](https://www.jeedom.com/en/): using official Z-Wave JS [plugin](https://doc.jeedom.com/en_US/plugins/automation%20protocol/zwavejs/beta/) - [HomeSeer](https://homeseer.com/): Using [Z-Wave Plus Plugin](https://docs.homeseer.com/products/setting-up-the-z-wave-plus-plugin) - [Homebridge](https://homebridge.io/): Using [homebridge-zwave-usb plugin](https://github.com/sapireli/homebridge-zwave-usb) - [ioBroker](https://iobroker.com): Using the offical adapter [ioBroker.zwave-ws](https://github.com/arteck/ioBroker.zwavews) ## Documentation [Project documentation](https://zwave-js.github.io/zwave-js-ui/#/)
